meta.task: Live-RAM verification of analysis/hack-offsets.json claims + attack on its unresolved list
meta.data: analysis/dumps/newgame-spam: 29 in-game dumps (f003000-f019800; earlier ones are pre-intro blanks). State: new game, no starter, player idle in bedroom, map (4,1) pos (6,6).
meta.method: Pointers from iwram+0x5AD0/4/8 (match pointers.txt in all dumps). Per-claim verdict = confirmed / consistent (value-degenerate: right value but zero/default so position not independently proven) / indeterminate / refuted, each with cited bytes from reference dump f019800 unless noted.
meta.key_limits: fresh save: party empty, bag/PC empty, dex zero, coins 0, key-dependent checks moot (no encryptionKey exists per static analysis)

unknown_0x6E0.evidence: u16@0x6E0 = 0, but 0x6E2-0x6E9 = bb ff ff ff ff ff ff ff = the player name 'A' again. A {u16, name[8]} record at 0x6E0

tail_struct_0xF5C.evidence: u8 minute @0xF5F, u8 second @0xF60 (u16@0xF5C and u8@0xF5E stay 0 = hour/day fields). Advances ~+90 in-game seconds per 600 frames (10 real s), 10-second-quantized (observed deltas 90-100) ~ 9x real time: f003000 1m20s -> f006000 9m00s -> f019800 44m30s. NOT a save counter. The 8-byte clock (0xF5C-0xF63) ends exactly at the claimed block end 0xF64, matching hack-offsets' 'memset(SB2+0xF5C, ?, 8) tail struct'

encryptionKey_absent.evidence: vanilla 0xAC reads 0; money/flags/vars all plaintext at their claimed offsets; nothing key-shaped nonzero in SB2 head

size_0xF64.evidence: the clock struct ends exactly at 0xF64. Data seen beyond sb2ptr+0xF64 in earlier passes is NOT SaveBlock2: SB2 buffer 0x0200DBEC + 0xFE4 = 0x0200EBD0 = SB1 buffer base exactly, so sb2ptr+0xF64..0xFE3 crosses into inter-block ASLR slack holding STALE COPIES of SB1's head from previous shifts (the 'warp records' decode as SB1[0x00..0x0B]: pos (6,6) + location (4,1,-1,6,6); e.g. f019800 sb2p+0xF80 = 0x0200EBD4 = SB1buf+4 while live SB1ptr is 0x0200EC38). Their 'volatility' is shift churn. This reconciles the fingerprint's 0xFE4 spacing (0xF64 + up-to-0x7C shift fits) and retro-explains v1's 'SB2 extension is live' claim as an artifact of reading past the true end

gameStats.verdict: consistent with removed (no positive evidence of existence)
gameStats.evidence: monotonic-counter scan across 29 dumps over full SB1+SB2+EWRAM+IWRAM found nothing stat-like incrementing (only frame counters @0x02038AF8/0x03003B84 and ASLR artifacts). Caveat: the idle player accrues no steps and no confirmed save occurred, so a dormant all-zero stats array would be invisible to this method - the removal evidence remains primarily static (no GetGameStat-shaped code)

mail@0x910.evidence: 0x910-0xB4F is ALL ZERO. Vanilla ClearMail would leave 0xFFFF word patterns, so either the hack zero-fills mail or mail is elsewhere. Static save/load-loop evidence unrefuted but unconfirmed. NOTE: a 16 x 36-byte array with the classic empty-mail pattern (ff x26 + species=1) sits at 0x1D98 - either a second mail-shaped array or the real mail; a dump with an actual mail item would settle it
